cards.text: Amos, a shepherd from Tekoa, sees visions about Israel (Amos 1:1). In his last one, the LORD said the end had come for His people Israel (Amos 8:2). Now the prophet says, “I saw the Lord standing beside the altar, and He said:”

cards.question: Standing beside the altar, the Lord gives an order about the pillars. What does He say to do to their tops?

answers.text: Strike them so the thresholds shake
Wash them so the altar stays clean
Coat them so the gold shines bright

cards.text: Then the Lord says to topple those pillars on the heads of all the people, and He will kill the rest with the sword. This one's heavy, friend.

cards.question: The Lord says a few of the people who flee will get away.

cards.text: Then the Lord goes through one hiding spot after another, starting at the bottom. “Though they dig down to Sheol, from there My hand will take them;”

cards.question: Digging down to Sheol won't work. So what does the Lord say He'll do if they climb up to heaven?

answers.text: Leave them up there for good

cards.text: Hide on top of Carmel, and the Lord says He'll track them there and seize them. Down deep, up high, mountaintop: there is no place out of His reach.

cards.question: If they hide from the Lord at the bottom of the sea, He'll command the ___ to bite them.

cards.text: Even captivity won't hide them. If their enemies drive them off as captives, the Lord says He'll command the sword to slay them there.

cards.question: The Lord says He will fix His eyes on them for harm and not for good.

cards.text: Then comes a picture of the Lord GOD of Hosts. He touches the earth and it melts, and all its dwellers mourn.

cards.question: In this picture of the Lord GOD of Hosts, all the land rises like the ___, then sinks like the river of Egypt.

cards.text: The picture keeps going: “He builds His upper rooms in the heavens and founds His vault upon the earth.”

cards.question: The Lord GOD of Hosts summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth.

cards.text: The picture ends: “The LORD is His name.” Then the LORD asks Israel about the Cushites, the people of Cush, the land past Egypt's border (Ezekiel 29:10): “Are you not like the Cushites to Me, O children of Israel?”

cards.question: The LORD asks if He didn't bring Israel up from the land of Egypt. Who does He say He brought up from Caphtor?

cards.text: And the LORD says He brought up the Arameans, the people of Damascus (Amos 1:5), from Kir.
Then He says His eyes are on the sinful kingdom, and He will destroy it from the face of the earth. But stay with me, friend, because the LORD isn't done talking.

cards.question: The LORD says He will utterly destroy the house of Jacob.

cards.text: Then the LORD says He'll give the command and shake the house of Israel among all the nations, as grain is sifted in a sieve. I know a sieve, friend: I once sifted so much flour my mustache came out WHITE for a week.

cards.question: The LORD will shake the house of Israel like grain in a sieve. What does He say about the pebbles?

answers.text: Not one will reach the ground
All will fall to the ground

cards.question: Last line: the LORD says all the sinners among His people will die by the sword. Which sinners does He point to?

answers.text: Those who say disaster will never reach them
Those who say the LORD has gone silent
Those who say the prophets are lying
